notes: The 1.1.1 editorial revision retains the OCFL 1.1 object declaration and inventory type URI.
The package is one OCFL Object, not an OCFL Storage Root.
OCFL specifies an object-at-rest layout, not a ZIP serialization or OCFL-specific archive media type.
The downloadable wrapper therefore uses the generic application/zip media type and a separate outer checksum.
